newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Jan soycomplex contract expiry quiet - trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Jan soycomplex contract expiry quiet - trade.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade January soybean, soymeal and soyoil contracts went off the board with little fanfare at 1201 CST/1801 GMT Wednesday, floor traders said.
The last trade in January soymeal was $248.00 per ton, up $1.30 from Tuesday.
The last trade in January soybeans was $7.37 per bushel, down 9-1/4 cents from Tuesday's close.
The last trade registered in January soyoil was 23.70 cents per lb, down 0.13 cent from Tuesday.
